annotations.text:
B · OPERATOR IDENTITY
Label affordance is the shared LabelEditor exactly as the Operators and Manual tabs use it — “+ label” when unset, “✎” revealed on row hover, on both the address head and each attachment row.
No owner badge: owner stays the filled pill it already is, and the hover hint is what finally explains it.
Hover any badge for its hint — the #12 MGR pill is pinned open so the hint reads without a cursor.

TODAY
The tab as it ships, for comparison: bare #12, no way to name an operator from here, and a filled MGR pill with nothing anywhere saying what filled means.

Two implementation notes this drawing depends on: .addr-card currently sets overflow: hidden, which would clip every tooltip — it has to become visible. And operatorLabels is not passed to SharedAddresses today, so the tab has to receive it (and its setter) the way OperatorList already does.
The type-tag hint shows the SDK enum name and the curveId the extension already holds — the SDK defines no human-readable expansion for DEF / LEA / PO, so inventing one would have been a guess.

A · PICK THE ROLE  (click the pills)
Not chosen, still open: selecting an attachment connects as primaryRole — the first role entry — so an address holding MGR and RWD on one operator always connects as manager, silently.

C · HONEST COUNTS
Not chosen, but this one is a live bug: a module whose fetch fails settles as answered with no data, so counts render as if complete and an address with CM attachments reads CSM-only.

D · SCAN WITHOUT EXPANDING
Not chosen. The count pill says how many, never what, so choosing a fixture costs one expand per address. The busiest of the four.
